# Portfolio workspace instructions

- Keep this project framework-free: semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript only when needed.
- Preserve the single-page responsive layout and use `styles.css` breakpoints to adapt the desktop composition to tablet and mobile.
- Match the Figma typography with Hanken Grotesk for display text and IBM Plex Mono for supporting copy.
- Keep source image exports in `assets/` and reference local files; do not add temporary Figma asset URLs.
- Run locally with `python3 -m http.server 4173`.
